title: Projection freshness is a lease, not just a cache TTL
subtitle: A complete directory observation gives each record an absolute expiry. The gateway bounds cache misses before the resolver, and never grants a request using an expired positive answer.

groups.title: Directory observation · outside or inside VNet
Resolver · read-only identity; inbound depends on SKU

nodes.title: 1 · Finish the whole scan
lines: Snapshot: [[snapshot]]
Export uses the operator's Graph token; in-VNet reads use the writer's grant.
Read users and service principals transitively; follow every [[next]].
[[reconcile]] records scan start as [[verified]], a UUID [[generation]], and [[expiry]].
Default and maximum lease: 7,200 seconds. A failed scan publishes nothing.

nodes.title: 2 · Reconcile, do not renew replay
lines: [[writer]]
Snapshot import preserves its generation and expiry.
Page existing records with [[fetch]]; write in bounded [[upsert]] batches.
Refresh unchanged members too. Delete orphans; kept or failed-to-delete orphans are not renewed.
Empty replacement is refused unless explicit. Partial failure or expiry exits nonzero.

nodes.title: 3 · Cosmos DB entitlement
lines: One record per oid; id and partition key are that oid.
Carries tenant, tier, unit / team, mapping version and absolute freshness.
Writer: Data Contributor on one container. Resolver: Data Reader on that container.
[[network]] defaults to private-only. Key authentication is off.
A partial apply can leave mixed generations. There is no atomic cross-partition cutover.

nodes.title: 4 · Cache hit or miss
lines: Key: [[key]]
Check positive expiry on every hit.
Store for min([[ttl]], remaining lease).
A miss goes to admission below; the cache never extends a lease.
Negative cache: min(60s, configured window).

nodes.title: 5 · Admission before lookup
lines: [[misses]]
At most 200 misses/s and 100 concurrent misses.
Beyond that envelope: retryable 429, Retry-After 1.
Within it: gateway MI calls the resolver; 5-second request timeout.
Approximate, not a throughput guarantee.

nodes.title: 6 · Authenticated Function
lines: GET [[route]]
[[auth]] allows the gateway identity, correct tenant and audience only.
[[inbound]] = private, except Basic v2 public+Entra.
Two warm 2-GB instances; 100 HTTP requests each.
No result cache after a read.

nodes.title: 7 · One read per identity / process
lines: [[lookup]] shares concurrent same-oid reads.
100 distinct in-flight reads per process; 3.5-second deadline and abort signal.
Cosmos transport timeout: 2.5 seconds; throttling retries disabled.
An aborted read keeps its slot until transport settles. No cross-host single flight.

nodes.title: 8 · Validate the stored record
lines: [[to-entitlement]]
Check tenant, supported tier, generation, scan time and absolute expiry.
Read by id + partition key over the Cosmos private endpoint.
A future scan time or a lease longer than two hours is invalid.

nodes.title: 9 · Distinguish absence from fault
lines: Fresh, entitled record: return 200 with expiry; continue the gateway policy.
Missing / not-yet-effective record: resolver 404 becomes gateway 403.
Expired / malformed freshness or resolver failure: gateway 503, Retry-After 5.
No fallback to old lists. A healthy retry is not proof that membership changed.

notice: A stopped sync bounds admission of new requests to two hours from the last successful scan's start, subject to clock skew and directory replication; it does not terminate an existing stream. Schedule scan + transfer + apply inside the lease, and alert on remaining lease as well as job failure.
